verdict.rationale: Composio documents a large catalog (1000+/1500+ toolkits/apps) and runtime 'meta-tools' that let an agent discover and authorize tools dynamically, plus a `toolkits` parameter to scope sessions, implying some discovery/browse capability. However there is no evidence of a developer-facing search/browse UI or catalog listing tools by capability before integration — discovery here is agent-runtime, not a pre-wiring browsing experience. Missing for 10: a documented searchable/browsable catalog UI or API for exploring tools by capability prior to agent wiring, and independent confirmation of such a browsing experience.
